packages.name: xgpui-macros
packages.reason: Compatible property-test code-generation fix for the proptest 1.12 Rust-path attribute syntax; packaged examples point to the matching framework release.

packages.name: xgpui
packages.reason: PlatformInput variant rename/addition, new required public struct fields, and matching core type identity; adds hot reload, native text notifications and benchmark support.

packages.name: xgpui-apple
packages.reason: MetalCustomContext.queue and objc2_queue are no longer public, struct literals are no longer supported, and new_renderer gains use_display_p3; adopt record(), queue_identity(), and core 2 types while preserving objc2-metal.

packages.name: xgpui-wgpu
packages.reason: Public WgpuRenderer::draw takes the core 2 Scene and renderer/custom-draw APIs expose core 2 geometry/traits; aligns WGSL sprite layout.

packages.name: xgpui-windows
packages.reason: WindowsPlatform implements the core 2 Platform contract; updates input variants, activation handling, helper pins and sprite shader layout.

packages.name: xgpui-ios
packages.reason: First proposed publication following gpui-unofficial 1.26.2. The iOS implementation is byte-identical to the upstream capture; package/dependency metadata and the simulator build script are adapted to XGPUI. Runtime simulator/device validation remains pending.

packages.name: xgpui-linux
packages.reason: Public current_platform/linux_platform return the core 2 Platform trait; updates scroll events and pinned 1.26.2 helpers.

packages.name: xgpui-macos
packages.reason: MacPlatform now implements the core 2 Platform contract and re-exported renderer primitives carry core 2 types; ships objc2 ABI/pasteboard/dialog fixes and Display P3 window wiring.

packages.name: xgpui-web
packages.reason: WebPlatform and browser window/input interfaces use core 2 types; updates scroll event construction and matching backend requirements.

packages.name: xgpui-platform
packages.reason: Re-exports core 2 Platform and returns core 2 Application; adds target-selected experimental iOS and a packaged focus-cleanup benchmark.

packages.name: xgpui-color
packages.reason: No packaged source, README or runtime dependency changes since the completed release; retain and verify the published payload.

packages.name: xgpui-parley
packages.reason: ParleyTextSystem implements core 2 PlatformTextSystem; public font/text contracts and platform dependency move to the matching core 2 family.

packages.name: xgpui-shader
packages.reason: Public painted elements and producers implement core 2 traits; native producers adopt Apple 3 host-owned record() batching. Existing objc2 ownership is retained.

packages.name: xgpui-svg
packages.reason: Public SVG element/renderer interfaces consume core 2 Window, geometry and element traits; exact core requirement changes.

packages.name: xgpui-canvas
packages.reason: The optional gpui integration exposes core 2 elements and shader 0.4 painter types. CPU-only camera/scene APIs are unchanged.

packages.name: xgpui-gamut
packages.reason: Public WideColor producers implement core 2 CustomContent and use shader 0.4/Apple 3 recording; GPU output and window contracts require the matching family.

packages.name: xgpui-media
packages.reason: Public elements, native frame exports and paint signatures use core 2/backend types; adds RasterSource, CanvasPaint, retained viewports, sampling-only adjustments and deferred admission retry.

compatibility_review: Manual supported-public-API review; automatic patch suggestions overridden.
rust_version_review: No declared rust-version changed; edition remains 2024. Rust 1.99.0 is validated; a lower MSRV is not established.
ios_publication: First proposed crates.io publication at 1.26.2, following the captured upstream version while the iOS implementation remains unchanged. Source equality is verified; package/dependency metadata and the example build script are adapted. Runtime-validation confidence is documented separately from package version.
